name: crossword
title: Crossword
description: Mini crosswords in the panel, from Crosshare: today's daily mini first, then as many more as you like (the daily archive back to 2020 and the newest minis). Type to fill, Space turns, Tab walks the clues; check and reveal a square, a word or the grid; a clock that only runs while the grid is on screen; streaks and times. Every key is saved, so Escape anywhere loses nothing.
author: pal

store.tagline: Mini crosswords from Crosshare: today's daily, then as many more as you like
features: Today's daily mini from Crosshare the moment you open it, then Next (Enter on the finish) goes straight to another unplayed one: the daily archive back to 2020, then the newest minis
The NYT Mini's keys: type to fill (full squares skipped), Backspace steps back, an arrow across the word turns first, Space or a click on the square turns, Tab and Shift-Tab walk the clues
The clue you are on large above the lists, the lists beside the grid with the crossing clue lit and finished clues greyed
Check or reveal a square, a word or the whole grid, and clear a word or the grid; wrong letters get a slash, revealed ones a corner mark; autocheck if you like
A clock that runs only while the grid is on screen, and a pause that hides the grid
A wave across the grid when it is solved, your time and whether it is a best; a full grid with a mistake says Not quite without saying where
Browse a calendar of the daily minis month by month, or the newest minis, each marked solved, started or new
Stats: solved, best and average time, the daily streak and the best one, a chart of recent times, the history
Every key is saved as you type: Escape anywhere, the half-done puzzle is there next time; puzzles once opened play offline
Each puzzle credited to its constructor, with a link to it on crosshare.org
